SCHED-01.note: Popover identity asserted via data-testid=scheduler-view. Geometry (250x525, radius 10px, bg rgb(38,38,38), border 1px solid rgb(61,61,61), two-layer shadow) matches scheduler-and-priority.md and matches meologue's popover byte-for-byte. This is a gap relative to the fuller anchoring check done on meologue.

SCHED-02.note: No 'This weekend' slot - consistent with pass2-2026-09-11.md's documented drift once the reference date is itself inside the weekend. Matches meologue's own live reading (Today/Tomorrow/This weekend/Next week) only in the sense that both showed 4 live-dependent slots; the exact 3rd/4th slot text differs between the two live reads because they were captured a session apart while Todoist's own product was mid-drift - recorded as environmental, not a meologue defect.

SCHED-03.beforeDateSet: No Date absent from quick options while the draft carries no date (see SCHED-02 raw list, no 'No Date' entry)
SCHED-03.note: Matches meologue: No Date appears only once a date is set.

SCHED-04.note: Identical phrases typed into the same 'Type a date' input in both apps. next friday -> Fri 25 Sep in both; every monday -> Mon 14 Sep -> Forever in both; in 3 days -> Tue 15 Sep in both. Task-count suffix differs only because Todoist's account had 0 tasks on 15 Sep at read time (ZZ probe busy A/B already cleaned up) vs meologue's fixtures still seeded there (2 tasks) - not a product difference.

SCHED-06.note: M T W T F S S, identical to meologue.

SCHED-07.keyFinding: Today (Sep 12) is ALSO a Saturday (weekend) in the live account, exactly as in meologue. Todoist's today cell carries BOTH 'calendar__day--greyed' (weekend) and 'calendar__day--busy' (has real dated tasks) classes alongside being today, yet still renders the TODAY red rgb(226,106,96) + bold 700, not the weekend grey rgb(204,204,204). This is the opposite of what was measured live in meologue for the identical calendar date: meologue's today cell on this same Saturday renders rgb(204,204,204) (the weekend colour), NOT its intended --td-calendar-today red, because a Tailwind arbitrary-variant ordering bug lets the weekend utility win the cascade over the today utility. Confirmed as a genuine meologue defect, not a documentation gap, using the identical live calendar date in both apps in the same session.

SCHED-08.note: Selected day (today, Sep 12, after typing 'tod') is a filled circle: background rgb(222,76,74), radius 12px, 24x24, white text, bold. Matches meologue's own SCHED-08 reading exactly.

SCHED-09.note: Today's own cell (Sep 12) already carries the 'calendar__day--busy' modifier because the account has real user tasks due today, independent of any ZZ probe fixture. ::before pseudo-element, 3x3px, background rgb(209,209,209), border-radius 1.5px, position absolute - no extra DOM node. Matches meologue's busy-dot mechanism and colour exactly (meologue: 3x3px rgb(209,209,209), border-radius fully round).

SCHED-10.note: Weekend (Sun 13, no other state) rgb(204,204,204)/400 vs weekday (Mon 14, no other state) rgb(255,255,255)/400. Matches meologue exactly (meologue weekend rgb(204,204,204)/400 vs weekday rgb(255,255,255)/400).

SCHED-11.meologue: No equivalent Time control exists anywhere in meologue's scheduler popover - confirmed absent by scanning the full popover outerHTML for the words 'Time'/'Repeat' (zero matches) in the earlier meologue pass of this same session.

SCHED-14.meologue: No dedicated Repeat dialog exists in meologue; the only recurrence entry point is typing a recurrence phrase into the scheduler's own 'Type a date' input (confirmed live this session: typing 'every monday' resolved to 'Mon 14 Sep -> Forever' with a recurring icon, same as SCHED-04).
